mainText: Hello, Verona! At 8 PM, here is today's balanced dish. We have clear skies near Badger Ridge Middle School and a lovely Waxing Gibbous moon. For the night owls, the International Space Station will be visible at 3:25 AM, appearing in the West Southwest over Mount Horeb and heading toward Madison near Home Depot. The overnight low will be 58 degrees, with no rain expected.
In city news, there are no new emails to report, and the police department has released their weekly summary of calls for service from August 17 through August 24.

There is plenty to do this week, starting with Yoga at Insight Wellness today. Tomorrow, you can enjoy trivia at Hop Haus or Lake Lou-ee. On Wednesday, check out Dream Day Trivia at Paddy Mac's, live music, the Verona Downtown Farmer's Market, and trivia at The Bogey Factory.

During their weekly operations, police handled several calls, including an incident on August 17 where officers located and arrested a man in the 500 block of Cross Country Road for a probation violation.
Today's flavor of the day is Dark Chocolate PB Crunch. Culver's is open until 10 PM tonight, so stop in soon. If you miss it, tomorrow's flavor is OREO Cookie Cheesecake.
